title.name: Casora
title.sub: A calm, photo-backed dashboard that sets itself up. Shape the rest room by room in a visual studio. No YAML.

new.title: Frigate camera
new.text: Live view with what Frigate detected last. Alerts and detections with clip, download, share and favourite, the recordings of the last days with a timeline.

new.title: Reolink doorbell
new.text: Live picture that says when someone rang. Listen in, send a quick reply, sound the siren and see who rang lately.

new.title: Coffee machine
new.text: Ready, heating up or brewing with progress, and what the machine needs. Start drinks from the popup. Home Connect, Miele, De'Longhi, Jura, Melitta, La Marzocco or a smart plug.

new.title: Robot lawn mower
new.text: Mowing, parked or trapped, the battery as a ring, to station, mow and park, and the mowing time of the last 7 days. Husqvarna Automower, Gardena, Worx Landroid, Segway Navimow, Ecovacs GOAT and Mammotion.

items.title: Desktop
items.text: Room by room. A full photo of each room, with its devices right below and every room one tap away.

items.title: Wall tablet
items.text: Made for the hallway. Large tiles, readable from across the room, and a look that stays calm all day.

items.title: Phone
items.text: Your favourites first, a navigation bar under your thumb. Tiles can grow while something is going on and shrink again after.

popups.title: Room climate
popups.text: Temperature and humidity of every room, with a day of readings.

popups.title: Every wash
popups.text: Washer and dryer with their program, time left and energy.

popups.title: Fuel
popups.text: When to refuel, and where it is cheapest right now.

popups.title: Plants
popups.text: What a plant needs, in plain words.

hold.title: The quick menu
hold.text: The main action on top: turn off, unlock, pause. Below it brightness and colour, position, temperature, volume. Then history, device and Edit tile.

hold.title: Timers
hold.text: Turn off in 30 minutes or on for 2 hours. The tile shows a ring that empties over time. Timers survive a restart and step aside when you switch by hand.

hold.title: It stays in Casora
hold.text: A reading opens its chart with 24 hours, 7 or 30 days. A window contact shows when it was open. Each with a back arrow, not Home Assistant's dialog.

hold.title: Ask first, then switch
hold.text: Any tile can ask before it switches. Unlock, Open door and the alarm always ask. When you arm the alarm, Casora names open windows and doors.

tiles.title: Every home
tiles.text: Lights and light groups, switches, scenes, blinds and covers, locks, thermostats and room climate, fans, air purifiers, humidifiers, media players, cameras and doorbells.

tiles.title: Safety
tiles.text: Alarm system, doors and windows, smoke, water and gas sensors, official warnings.

tiles.title: Energy and house
tiles.text: Energy with solar and home battery, batteries of all devices, network, updates, waste collection, calendar, Pulse.

tiles.title: Appliances
tiles.text: Washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, fridge, coffee machine, robot vacuum, robot lawn mower, 3D printer.

tiles.title: On the road
tiles.text: Car with fuel prices nearby, e-bike.

tiles.title: Hobbies
tiles.text: Plants, aquariums, football, game activity (PlayStation, Steam, Discord), recipe of the week.

tiles.title: Community cards
tiles.text: Frigate camera, Reolink doorbell, Velair thermostat, chart, pet tracker. They wait in the Studio until you add them.

tiles.title: Your own
tiles.text: Any Home Assistant card as a custom tile.

studio.title: See it before you save
studio.text: Switch the preview between desktop, tablet and phone. Nothing is written until you click Save, and a draft survives a reload.

studio.title: Go back in time
studio.text: Every save becomes a version. Preview any earlier one and restore it with a click. Nothing is ever lost.

studio.title: New devices find their place
studio.text: The device assistant spots what is new in your home and suggests the room and the tile. You decide.

studio.title: Hold is configurable
studio.text: Under Settings, Controls, Hold on tiles picks what press and hold does: quick menu, popup or Home Assistant dialog, for all tiles or one.

items.title: Casora
items.text: The default. Warm linen and sand, large corners, soft shadows.

items.title: Casora Nebel
items.text: The same calm design in cool grey with a petrol accent.

items.title: Casora Glas
items.text: Frosted glass over your room photos. In performance mode the glass turns opaque for older tablets.
